notes.title: Hotfix for Input Device Problems
notes.notes:
A couple of recent streams have shown issues where an input device seems to be firing tons of improper inputs without the person actually pressing anything.

I've added some code to detect situations like this, and a menu that allows users to enable/disable specific input devices.  You can open this new menu by holding down ~ or start for 2 seconds, but if you haven't had any issues then you shouldn't need to mess with this menu.

notes.title: The Survival Mode Update
notes.notes:
This game update is the biggest yet!  It includes:
[list]
[*] [b]2 new game modes[/b]
[*] [b]5 new levels[/b]
[*] [b]4 new achievements[/b]
[*] [b]tons of bug fixes and other game improvements[/b]
[/list]
[h1]New Game Modes![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38228064/5e1bf8c0c4d196944f96ac05cbd106ebdbc6ad0d.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Standard: The old version of PogoChamp: beat levels quickly to earn stars and climb the tower.
[*] Survival: See how many levels you can beat with only 10 lives!
[*] Daily Challenge: 10 levels are chosen randomly, how many can you beat with only 3 lives! The levels change every 24 hours.
[/list]
[h1]New Levels[/h1]
If you're looking to jump straight to the new levels, they are levels 42, 51, 54, 57, 58. I also reworked "Salmon" and it is now level 31.  Don't forget you can use the "Quick Select" menu to quickly jump between levels (it's on the left side of the level select screen).

notes.title: Controller Prompt Hotfix

notes.title: Minor update

notes.title: Mini Update: Crash Log Uploader, NVIDIA Highlights, and New Icons.
notes.notes:
* Added automatic crash log uploading on Windows (MacOS coming soon).
* Fix null pointer related to controller rumble when no controller is connected.
* Fix issue where opening pause menu could cause skid SFX to play until you unpaused.
* Hidden attempts in replays no longer affect how long it takes to automatically loop the replay.
* Buttons are now recorded in replays.
* Cannon activation & shooting is now recorded in replays.
* Tilt sensitivity settings now only affect rotation speed, and no longer affect air acceleration (preventing issues where certain levels could not be completed at low tilt sensitivity).
* Update icons to new versions.

notes.title: Minor fixes & Unity version update.
notes.notes:
I've gotten reports from some users that the game crashes when they hit the Play button in the main menu after "Loading..." appears on screen.  One user managed to resolve this by updating their graphics card drivers.  I've tried updating the version of Unity I use to build the game, in the hopes that using newer versions of Unity and its render pipeline will resolve some of these issues.  if you are having this issue, PLEASE send me the crash log so I can resolve it for others.  You can find the crash log at: Windows: C:\Users\<YOUR_USERNAME>\AppData\LocalLow\PogoChamp\PogoChampGame\Player.log

Please send the log file to support@pogochampgame.com

* Fix bug where rings would not appear active if they were see through when you activated them.
* Fix bug where Jackpot pegs would not appear active if they were see through when you activated them.
* Fix warning when checking High Score Mode setting.
* Add star count to end of levels scene.
* Scores in Jackpot and Skee-Ball are now recorded in replays.
* Move some gates in Level Select.
* Update Unity version from 2020.3.0f1 to 2020.3.4f1.
* Update some Unity assets.
